_comment: Central animation settings for Bill Bee. Change values here, then reload the app. Times ending in Ms use milliseconds; times ending in Seconds use seconds.

transitions._comment: Shared CSS transition speeds used by links, buttons, cards, the navbar, and glass layers.
transitions._glassMs: Fade speed for the liquid-glass navbar layers.
transitions._navbarMs: Time for the navbar to morph into or out of its pill shape.
transitions._easeOutCss: Shared smooth deceleration curve for emphasized CSS motion.

navbar._comment: Controls when the navbar begins its animated pill transformation.
navbar._compactAfterPx: Vertical scroll distance before the navbar becomes compact.

smoothScroll._comment: Lenis page and anchor scrolling behavior.
smoothScroll._durationSeconds: Approximate time for wheel smoothing and section-link navigation to settle; lower is faster.
smoothScroll._wheelMultiplier: Scales wheel input; lower values make wheel scrolling gentler.

sectionSnap._comment: Gentle Lenis proximity snapping between landing-page sections and horizontal story panels.
sectionSnap._durationSeconds: Time used to settle onto a nearby section.
sectionSnap._distanceThresholdPercent: How close scrolling must stop before a section attracts it; lower values feel less aggressive.
sectionSnap._debounceMs: Wait after wheel or touch input before considering a snap. New input releases the current snap.

cursorTrail._comment: Controls the dotted cursor trail and how quickly it follows and disappears.
cursorTrail._fontSizePx: Size of each dash in the trail.
cursorTrail._maxPoints: Maximum number of visible trail dashes.
cursorTrail._shrink: How much older trail points shrink, from 0 to 1.
cursorTrail._fade: How much older trail points fade, from 0 to 1.
cursorTrail._smoothing: Follow smoothing; higher values feel softer and slower.
cursorTrail._exitDurationSeconds: Fade-out time after a trail point is released.
cursorTrail._removalIntervalMs: How frequently old trail points are removed.
cursorTrail._directionThresholdPx: Minimum pointer movement before the bee changes direction.

select._comment: GlideSelect menu, highlight, and feedback animation timings.
select._glideDurationMs: Time for the active highlight to glide between options.
select._interactionDurationMs: Trigger press and selected-label swap time.
select._feedbackDurationMs: Option, highlight-opacity, and reduced-motion feedback time.
select._closeBufferMs: Small safety delay before a closed menu is removed from the DOM.

rotatingText._comment: Hero keyword rotation. The interval includes the time each word remains readable.
rotatingText._rotationIntervalMs: Time between one highlighted hero word and the next.
rotatingText._staggerDurationSeconds: Delay between letters during each word change.
rotatingText._springStiffness: Pull of the letter spring; higher values settle faster.
rotatingText._springDamping: Resistance on the letter spring; higher values reduce bounce.

magicBento._comment: Interaction and fake-data count-up behavior for the connected-workflow bento.
magicBento._intro: Set to false to disable the staggered card entrance.
magicBento._enableBorderGlow: Shows a restrained border highlight near the pointer.
magicBento._enableSpotlight: Shows the soft pointer-following light across nearby cards.
magicBento._clickEffect: Adds the subtle press ripple when a metric card is clicked.
magicBento._countDurationSeconds: Time for each fake metric to count to its value.
magicBento._countDelaySeconds: Wait before the first metric starts counting.
magicBento._countStaggerSeconds: Extra delay added between consecutive metric counters.

logoLoop._comment: Continuous movement used by the customer logo rows.
logoLoop._speed: Primary row travel speed in pixels per second.
logoLoop._secondarySpeed: Second row travel speed in pixels per second.
logoLoop._hoverSpeed: Travel speed while a pointer is over a logo row.
logoLoop._intro: Set to false to remove the initial logo reveal.

cardSwap._comment: Autoplay and movement character for the testimonial card stack.
cardSwap._delayMs: Time each testimonial stays at the front before the stack advances.
cardSwap._speed: Overall card movement multiplier; lower values move more slowly.
cardSwap._bounce: Amount of spring overshoot when a card settles.
cardSwap._hoverSpread: How far the stacked cards fan apart on hover.
cardSwap._intro: Set to false to remove the initial stack entrance.

textReveal._comment: Default word, letter, and line reveal used by ScrollText components.
textReveal._offsetPx: Starting distance from the final text position.
textReveal._durationSeconds: Reveal time for each text segment.
textReveal._ease: Cubic-bezier curve expressed as four numbers.
textReveal._viewportAmount: Portion of the text that must enter the viewport before revealing.

horizontalStory._comment: Horizontal panels and their heading reveal.
horizontalStory._springStiffness: How strongly the horizontal track follows scroll progress.
horizontalStory._springMass: Virtual weight of the horizontal track.
horizontalStory._travelVw: Physical horizontal distance in viewport widths across three panels.
horizontalStory._headingOffsetPx: Vertical starting offset for panel headings.
horizontalStory._headingEase: Motion easing preset for panel headings.

pricingCards._comment: Entrance animation for the pricing-card group.
pricingCards._replayOnReentry: When true, cards animate again whenever the pricing section re-enters the viewport.
pricingCards._distancePx: Vertical travel distance before cards settle.
pricingCards._ease: GSAP easing curve for the entrance.
pricingCards._threshold: Visible portion required before the cards animate.
